checks.text: With no image loaded, the page shows the heading "Image Flipper", the text "Drop an image or click to browse", and the buttons "Flip H", "Flip V", "Rotate 90°", and "Download" are all disabled.

After dropping a 100x50 PNG file named "test.png" into the drop zone, the preview canvas displays the image, the status text shows "Loaded: test.png", and the buttons "Flip H", "Flip V", "Rotate 90°", and "Download" are all enabled.
After loading a 100x50 image, clicking the button "Flip H" once updates the status text to "Loaded: test.png (Flipped H)" and the preview canvas shows the image mirrored horizontally.
After loading a 100x50 image, clicking the button "Flip V" once updates the status text to "Loaded: test.png (Flipped V)" and the preview canvas shows the image mirrored vertically.

After loading a 100x50 image, clicking the button "Rotate 90°" once updates the status text to "Loaded: test.png (Rotated 90°)" and the preview canvas shows the image rotated 90 degrees clockwise, with the canvas dimensions now 50x100.

After loading a 100x50 image, clicking "Flip H" then "Rotate 90°" updates the status text to "Loaded: test.png (Flipped H, Rotated 90°)" and the preview canvas shows the image both flipped horizontally and rotated 90 degrees clockwise.
After loading a 100x50 image and applying "Flip H", clicking the button "Download" triggers a file download named "test_flipped.png" and the status text remains "Loaded: test.png (Flipped H)".
After loading a 100x50 image, clicking "Rotate 90°" four times returns the status text to "Loaded: test.png" and the preview canvas shows the original image orientation with dimensions 100x50.

Reload keeps the loaded image and its transformations: after loading "test.png" and clicking "Flip H", reloading the page still shows the status text "Loaded: test.png (Flipped H)" and the preview canvas displays the horizontally flipped image.
